words.def: to agree to do something and stick to it
words.ex: It is hard to {commit to} a yearly subscription when you are unsure.

words.def: a short time when you can try something before paying fully
words.ex: The app offers a two-week {trial period} before you pay.

words.def: easy to understand or do; not complicated
to choose not to continue with something you are part of
words.ex: You can {opt out} of the emails at any time.

words.def: something you must have or do to join or qualify
words.ex: One {requirement} is that you must be over eighteen.

words.def: able to change easily to suit different situations
words.ex: The monthly plan is far more {flexible} than the yearly one.

words.def: to extend a subscription or membership for another period
words.ex: I decided to {renew} my gym membership for another year.

words.def: a list of people who want to join something that is currently full
words.ex: The course is full, but you can join the {waiting list}.
